heading: Make room for learning.
subtitle: Your lesson audio and slides, together on your device.
slidesPending: End recording, then Recover / export to rebuild the slide gallery.
statusBody: Open LectureLens in Chrome → Preview your lesson → Choose slide area in the large editor → Start recording.
nextTitle: A private space for your lessons
nextBody: You can switch to other tabs while recording. Keep the selected tab on the lesson. Closing this desktop window does not stop recording; use End & save in the extension.
scope: Stored on this device. Delete recordings when you no longer need them. Transcription and PDF notes are coming later.
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this session and its raw recording?
stopRequested: Stop requested. Keep Chrome open while the final chunks are saved, then refresh.
sessionHelp: Select a session to view its slides, recover saved audio, or manage the recording.
empty: No recordings yet. Start your first lesson from the Chrome extension.
